title: Make the Codex cleanup feature doc point to the complete pre-removal prerequisites
outcome: The feature doc cannot be read as a shorter alternative checklist to the shared cleanup rule.
acceptance: The cleanup paragraph in docs/features/shared-codex-app-server.md includes terminal-run outcome recovery, frozen-input and unique-unpushed-change checks or clearly identifies its list as partial and defers to the full AGENTS.md rule.

The text preserves existing authorization, containment/link/retention/live/shared-resource and stop-after-failure rules, with required review/gate and authority-text process where applicable; no Markdown phrase tests are added.
